mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_salary), 0) as totalSalary, COALESCE(SUM(gross_salary), 0) as grossTotal, COUNT(1) as count FROM salary_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND month = #{month}

SELECT month, COALESCE(SUM(net_salary), 0) as totalSalary FROM salary_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH), '%Y-%m') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT COALESCE(d.name, '未分配部门') as departmentName, COALESCE(SUM(s.net_salary), 0) as totalSalary FROM salary_record s LEFT JOIN sys_employee e ON s.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.month = #{month} GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY totalSalary DESC
